title: The Fall of Yun Shan
summary: The Angry Buddha Lotus Flame explodes over Misty Cloud Mountain and both sides fall back. Xiao Yan and Yun Shan survive, and Xiao Yan beats Yun Shan down for his father, his clan and his brothers, then kills him. Protector Wu attacks Yao Lao, then uses the Nine-Darkness Hundred-Devour Soul to swallow Yun Shan's soul and the souls of many Misty Cloud elders. Nalan Yanran comes out of seclusion after passing the Gate of Life and Death. Yun Yun tells her the Hall of Souls is the true enemy and leads the sect's Covering Sun Cloud Formation against Protector Wu, but he seals the space and breaks it. Yao Lao sends Xiao Yan to Hai Bodong and faces Protector Wu alone. Xiao Yan prepares one more Angry Buddha Lotus Flame to save him.
